class.name: SociQueryDispatcher
class.brief_description: Background SOCI worker with a bounded request queue. Call poll() on the Godot main thread.
class.description: Background SOCI worker with a bounded request queue. Call poll() on the Godot main thread. See res://addons/godot_soci/docs/API.md for usage examples, threading limitations and failure handling.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts a dedicated database worker; does not guarantee that the connection succeeded.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops and joins the worker. May block until a running SQL operation ends.

method.name: is_started
method.description: True when the worker has started, not necessarily connected.

method.name: pending
method.description: Number of queued, executing and not-yet-delivered requests.

method.name: get_connection_state
method.description: Last observed session state: stopped, connecting, connected, failed or disconnected. Does not automatically reconnect.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Backlog counters and average native queue, execution and delivery delays in milliseconds.

method.name: query_async
method.description: Queues a SELECT and returns a request, or null on backpressure/error.

method.name: transaction_async
method.description: Queues an atomic batch with rollback on statement errors and optional affected-row guards.

method.name: poll
method.description: Delivers up to max_completions finished requests on the main thread.

signal.name: connection_state_changed
signal.description: Main-thread notification when the observed worker state changes. Short intermediate states may be skipped.
